title: 30 By ANT
description: EEG recordings from participants receiving a series of laser stimuli while rating pain intensity. After an initial calibration to find the laser energy that yielded an average rating of 7, each participant received 30 laser stimuli and verbally rated each one on a 0-10 pain scale. The dataset supports research on the neural correlates of pain perception.
methods_description: Participants first received laser stimuli of varying intensities so that the energy corresponding to an average rating of 7 could be identified. Each participant then received 30 laser stimuli while keeping their eyes open and fixating on a crosshair. After each stimulus there was a five-second pause, followed by a verbal pain rating on a 0-10 scale. The next trial began about 5 seconds after the rating. All laser event markers are delayed by 100 ms.
